scope: Two actual Ubuntu24.04 Node22/26 synthetic managed-helper/HTTP suites with owned process lifecycle, negative declaration checks and generated dist equality. Exact185-input maps match recorded local306. No actual Rust/native Node, model/provider/telephone/remote, installation/performance or full SDK qualification. Native Linux job in this run is separately observed, not inferred from these two jobs.

summary.scope: Synthetic owned raw/typed helper lifecycle, typed local operation reconstruction, negative declaration checks and fake local HTTP only. Fixture-shaped signatures are not cryptographic, real-server, installed parity or full G6-062 qualification.
functions: canonical HTTP uses current path/bearer and captures intent before yielding
canonical HTTP configuration rejects implicit remote/credential URL destinations
canonical HTTP refuses invalid/missing mutation intent and live/native paths without writing
canonical HTTP rejects mismatched profile, correlation, scope, signatures and terminal order
canonical HTTP enforces duplicate-key, UTF8, MIME and HTTP status boundaries
canonical HTTP accepts a bounded multi-envelope batch larger than one envelope
canonical HTTP structured refusals retain current identity and never become transport retries
canonical HTTP refusal code must agree with HTTP and public diagnostics stay closed
canonical HTTP never follows redirects with bearer or retries an uncertain mutation
canonical HTTP one absolute deadline includes a partially delivered body
canonical HTTP cancellation after admission preserves logical mutation identity
canonical HTTP finite journal responses bind every nested resource and cursor
canonical HTTP caps active requests and close joins cancelled work without retry
current helper captures canonical intent, independent exchange IDs and original Rust signatures
configuration is explicit and invalid intent/aborted requests never write helper input
queued deadline removes only the unsent intent and later work uses the same original helper
queued cancellation keeps the helper and cannot become a submitted mutation
sent deadline includes partial output, fences helper and retains the saved mutation key
sent cancellation fences this instance without restarting or retrying
corrupt, oversized, unsigned, duplicate or foreign helper replies fail closed and are never retried
late uncorrelated output fences an otherwise idle original helper
structured refusals are redacted and leave the helper usable
helper exit leaves sent work uncertain and no replacement helper is created
missing executable proves no submission and still has an owned close
queue capacity and close settle every original wait and join the child
bounded close reports unconfirmed cleanup and kills the original hanging helper
typed restore and recover are local, immutable and bound to the declared result/scope
typed mutations capture original intent; handles complete through a separate SDK journal wait
typed Conversation creation resolves a handle and refresh remains current
decisions retain their own IDs and scope separately from the target reference
structured SDK errors retain trust, missing receipts and recorded certainty without raw diagnostics
invalid typed inputs and already aborted mutations never write the helper
queued typed deadline removes only unsent work and passes the remaining deadline to Rust
submitted typed deadline fences the original helper; saved recovery never resubmits
corrupt helper framing, cross-operation observations and wrong typed results fail closed
readiness/completion never accept an arbitrary status as a completed result
missing executable is not submitted and explicit close joins; hanging close reports incomplete cleanup
one owned operation rejects a changed host record identity across separate API calls
typed participants preserve Conversation scope and independent mutation/revision identity
invalid participant scopes, identity kinds and noninteger revisions never write
participant results and refresh observations cannot cross Conversation scope
